title: Synthetic research decision-rule conformance; not biological or clinical validation
scope: Deterministic evaluator of supplied estimates and qualification assertions. Eligibility means independent research replication only.

expected_case_freeze.state_at_freeze: Expected outcomes written manually; no evaluator or test implementation exists in this directory yet. No evaluator executed.
expected_case_freeze.independence_limit: Expected outcomes independent of evaluator execution, not independently authored or externally preregistered. Local hash receipt is not a trusted timestamp.
expected_case_freeze.preimplementation_refinement: Added explicit separate fate measurement/coverage qualification and three cases before any evaluator or test implementation. No result-driven expectation changes.

comparators.naive_protein_only: Accept any finite BubR1 protein ratio > 1; ignores function, fate, exposure, uncertainty and controls.
comparators.naive_survivor_only: Accept any finite positive change in normal-cell fraction among survivors; ignores function per division, selection, fate, exposure, uncertainty and controls.
comparators.interpretation: Illustrative failure modes only. Neither rule represents a named competitor. Case frequency is chosen, not sampled: counts do not estimate sensitivity, specificity, error rates or field superiority.

statistical_simulation.reason: No measured pilot variance or overdispersion is available. Invented parameters would not establish assay power or comparative benefit. Supplied CIs are synthetic fixtures, not fitted to the illustrative counts.

hard_limits: Expected cases and implementation have the same author. Expectations precede implementation execution, not independent human adjudication or external preregistration.
No mutant BubR1 rescue, actual N1002K defect, drug efficacy, patient benefit, causal mechanism or clinical threshold is demonstrated.
All reference strings, thresholds, counts and intervals in fixtures are synthetic. Passing three example cultures is not a power calculation.
The program cannot authenticate model qualification, pre-registration, exposure review, imaging, selection exclusion, statistical interval coverage, pilot records or independent culture identity.
No CI estimation, hierarchical model fitting or multiplicity adjustment is performed; qualified analyst-supplied results are required.
Only a first-completed-division-per-starting-cell design is supported. Repeated division data require a separately reviewed schema and analysis.
Comparison-family completeness is checked against the supplied declaration; undeclared experiments or changed declarations cannot be detected.
The phenotype classification / abundance-equivalence experiment is not implemented. A qualified stage-1 model is a declared prerequisite.
No deployment, runtime benchmark, external validation or medical-device validation is claimed.

structurally_valid_comparison.scope: Structurally valid inputs only, excluding schema and nonfinite failures. These still include declared failed controls and inconclusive results.

bounded_mutation_checks.scope: Seven deliberately faulty in-memory versions of our own evaluator; no files changed. Not exhaustive mutation coverage or biological simulation.
